slots.name: weight loss drug age range
slots.sentence: The health agency said weight-loss drugs may be considered for adolescents aged 10 to 19 with obesity but only after supervised interventions have failed.

slots.name: surgery treatment failure duration
slots.sentence: Bariatric surgery could be considered for physically and mentally mature adolescents with severe obesity after six months of unsuccessful treatment, it said.

slots.name: medication age limit
slots.sentence: For children under 10, WHO endorsed diet, physical activity and combined behavioral support instead of obesity medication, surgery or devices because of doubts over their safety and long-term effectiveness.

slots.name: Wegovy Saxenda age limit
slots.sentence: Novo Nordisk's NOVOb.CO Wegovy and Saxenda can be used by certain adolescents 12 and older in the United States and the European Union.

slots.name: Saxenda EU age range
slots.sentence: The EU also allows Saxenda for some children aged six to 11.

slots.sentence: The World Health Organization on Wednesday recommended diet, exercise and counseling over popular weight-loss drugs in its first global guidelines addressing rising obesity among younger children.
